d: Curtis is involved in an accident that alters his personality  C.J. takes over the twins' school project and strives for excellence.
Calvin wants his son in his wedding, but Miranda might not be on board.
Curtis suspects his food truck was blown up intentionally, and he starts investigating the incident  Calvin must get to the bottom of Calvin Jr.'s mischievous deeds.
While Calvin and Laura make wedding plans, Miranda has made plans of her own.
Ella decides to go against the grain and use technology instead of paying someone to do repairs  Malik and Lisa's argument causes discord between C.J. and Janine.
Calvin confesses to Ella that he thinks he would have been better off dead, so Curtis has a heart-to-heart with Calvin.
Following Curtis' medical checkup, Ella wants Curtis to improve his diet, prompting the Payne family to learn an important lesson in compromising.
Curtis has selfish motives for wanting the family to take a DNA test  it all backfires when he finds out about his heritage and when they discover Ella's family line.
Lisa helps Miranda set up her online dating profile.

Calvin and Laura try to teach the boys to clean up after themselves  Ella meets with the head deacon to discuss a tense situation, but she does not get the response she expected when she brings up some serious concerns.
Curtis revisits old habits  Laura and Calvin explore their new romance.
Calvin attempts to plan a bachelor party against Laura's will  Malik struggles with putting together a toy for his daughter.
Curtis wants to build his Sauce Boss brand and Ella needs to get women to register for the church's help center to receive a much-needed grant.
Ella runs a gun buy-back program at the Help Center  Curtis wants to volunteer at the Help Center.
Calvin and Laura put their engagement to the test, joining pre-marital counseling.
